sql: with p as (   select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) game, pnl, quantity q   from paper_trades   where strategy = 'mmsell10' and status in ('settled','closed_sl') and pnl is not null and quantity > 0     and created_at >= '2026-09-09T00:00:00Z'     and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH')), g as (select ser, game, sum(pnl) gp, sum(q) q, count(*) n from p group by 1,2) select ser, count(*) games, sum(n) trades, round(100*sum(gp)/sum(q),2) c_per_ct,   round(avg(gp),4) mean_g, round(stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)),4) se_g,   round(avg(gp) - 1.645*stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)),4) lcb, count(*) filter (where gp < 0) games_lost from g group by 1 order by 1
